units.source_text: 薰君听了这番话，似觉听到的是奇怪的梦呓，

en.t: When Lord Kaoru heard these words, it seemed to him as though he were hearing some strange dream talk,

units.source_text: 或者是巫女的自言自语，心中甚是纳罕。

en.t: or perhaps the mutterings of a shrine maiden, and he was greatly puzzled in his heart.

units.source_text: 但这是他一向怀疑的事，如今听这老侍女说起，颇思知道详情。

en.t: Yet this was something he had long suspected, and now that he heard the old gentlewoman speak of it, he very much wished to know the details.

units.source_text: 然而此时人目众多，未便探问。

en.t: But at that moment there were many eyes upon them, so it was not convenient to question her further.

units.source_text: 况且突如其来地细说旧事直到天明，也太煞风景了。

en.t: Besides, to suddenly begin recounting old matters in detail until daybreak would have been far too unseemly.

units.source_text: 于是回答她说：“你所说的我不甚明白。

en.t: So he answered her, saying, "I do not quite understand what you have told me.

units.source_text: 但既是旧事，我亦深为感动。

en.t: But since it concerns matters from the past, I too am deeply moved.

units.source_text: 将来必须请你将其余详情告我。

en.t: Sometime in the future I must ask you to tell me the rest of the details.

units.source_text: 雾快消散了，我衣冠不整，面目可憎，深恐小姐们见了责我无礼，

en.t: The mist will soon clear, and with my robes in disorder and my appearance so unsightly, I fear the young ladies may see me and reproach me for my discourtesy,

units.source_text: 因此不能随心所欲地长留在此，实甚遗憾。”

en.t: so I regret very much that I cannot remain here as long as I would like."
Then he rose and took his leave.

units.source_text: 此时隐隐听到八亲王所居山寺的钟声。

en.t: At that moment, the sound of the bell from the mountain temple where Prince Hachi lived could be heard faintly.
The thick mist still lay spread everywhere.

units.source_text: 想起古歌中“白云重重隔”“峰上白云多”之句，觉得这深山野处实甚可哀。

en.t: Remembering the old poems about white clouds lying layer upon layer between them and white clouds many upon the peaks, he felt that this remote mountain place was deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 薰君还是可怜这两位女公子，料想她们必然愁思无穷，

en.t: Lord Kaoru still felt pity for the two young ladies, imagining that their sorrowful thoughts must surely be endless,

units.source_text: 笼闭在这深山之中，安得不如此呢？

en.t: for shut away in the depths of these mountains, how could they be otherwise?
So he composed a poem and said:
